step1Body.en: Pick up the glasses featuring the Crizal Natural LookTM coating and put them on.

step2Body.en: Press START to take your photo, then adjust until your face is centered.

readyBody.en: Position your face inside the oval.

qrBody.en: Unlock your personalized Crizal® Natural Look™ photo  and enter the competition for a chance to win a pair  of Ray-Ban Meta Ai glasses
